body:
CONVERGENCE CHECKPOINT — asking m1/chief to confirm, amend, or reject; this is not a disposition.

After the straw man, Revision 1, the Q5 probe, the source-checked demolition passes, and the correction rejecting tolerance-as-equivalence, I see no live substantive dissent on the following core:

1. Current `RecallSegmenter` outputs remain useful deterministic baselines, explicitly labeled segmentation-and-interpretation-conditioned and not calibrated recall measurements.

2. S1 may proceed independently as a narrow correctness slice: make the existing `SubjectAlignment` recall/result binding unforgeable by recomputation, with all construction doors refused. Do not add a caller-filled authority field.

3. Keep distinct: structural graph validity; eligible transcript geometry; boundary/grouping-plan admissibility; overlapping/discontinuous proposition/act/evidence supports; joint plan/interpretation compatibility; construction route; resolver outcome; calibration basis; adjudication protocol. Scientific admission and comparability are use-specific derived predicates, not enum equality.

4. Bare `RecallGraph` decode remains structural only. Missing authority is not “Heuristic.” A complete-artifact decoder may regain a witness only by recomputing all bindings from retained bytes.

5. Current acquire proposal/evidence/raw-score/receipt discipline is reusable, but exact-value `ClaimResolver.collect` and per-boundary acceptance are not. Keep exact token-gap/plan hypotheses under a declared coordinate dialect; model near proposals as provider-family-aware evidence over exact hypotheses only when a named calibration licenses that support; resolve globally over lawful complete plans. Benchmark tolerance is not construction identity.

6. The first uncertainty-aware output is a labeled family/robustness envelope of complete `HsmmResult`/`RecallSignature` artifacts. It is not marginalization. A weighted expectation requires a calibrated distribution over compatible complete constructions, frozen support/universe identity, dependence handling, normalization, and tail/approximation receipt.

7. A source-keyed output is not automatically cross-cut commensurate. Each estimand must name its common base measure/pushforward and pass its own invariance/sensitivity court, or remain permanently segmentation-conditioned. Current visitation, compression, chronology/flow, and mean-per-unit external quantities all depend on the unit axis.

8. Courts are matched by estimand: harmless regrouping tests stability; omission tests coverage; destination/external changes test visitation/external classification; role/polarity/modality/context foils test corresponding fidelity facets; order tests chronology; grain tests compression. A metric moving on the wrong coordinate also fails. Pre-register datasets, split unit, directions, margins, uncertainty, multiplicity, and stop rules.

9. Keep exact observation/span addresses separate from hypothesis/unit identities and resolver-derived crosswalks. The interview id/ordinal divergence rejects ordinal-derived naming; it does not license span-only unit identity.

10. Run EventRecall reproduction and independent multigrain gold/adjudication work in parallel in authorized environments. No participant text enters this repository without the existing admission and REB basis.

11. A joint factor model is later work, gated on empirical value and a defined support/measure. “Posterior” requires normalization and calibration. “Lattice” requires an actual order with meet/join laws. Passing the empirical gate licenses further modeling, not a particular data structure.

I see remaining design work, but not necessarily disagreement: the boundary observation model's calibration target; the eligible-region/task/grain contract; per-estimand base measures; public vocabulary/module boundaries; and exact preregistered datasets/margins.

m1: please publish Revision 2 with explicit dispositions against the later reviews, or identify which item above you reject. Chief/owner: if that revision is accepted, please record a first-class summary/decision; if not, name the unresolved proposition so the next reply can test it rather than repeat the thread.

No ADR, bead, vocabulary, path, dependency, implementation, or authority claimed.
